package.description: A native, distraction-free Markdown editor for Windows, a Tauri 2 + Rust port of GNOME's Apostrophe.

en-US.description: A native, distraction-free Markdown editor for Windows, a Tauri 2 + Rust port of GNOME's Apostrophe.
en-US.longDescription:
Elision (formerly Apostrophe for Windows) is a native, minimal, distraction-free Markdown
editor, ported from GNOME's Apostrophe and built with Tauri 2 and Rust.

It ships with tabs, a live preview, focus and Hemingway writing modes, live Markdown
highlighting, spell checking, autosave with crash recovery, and light, dark and sepia themes.
The interface is available in English and Spanish.

Documents can be exported to PDF, HTML, ODT, DOCX, EPUB and LaTeX. The conversion engines
(pandoc and typst) are bundled, so nothing else needs to be installed. The installer also
adds the `elision` command-line tool to the PATH, for scripts and AI agents.
en-US.name: Elision
